description: Every segmentation model Corridor is validated to run. Weights are not part of the source tree; each entry pins the exact file by SHA-256, and a file that does not match is never loaded.

models.training_dataset_version: KK1KK2-combi: 71 hand-labelled phase-contrast stills of confined cells (KK1 40, KK2 31), 246 instances, from two instruments
models.notes: The lab's Cellpose 3 model trained on both labelled groups together (a cyto2 start, as its file name records). The pixel-size range spans the two instruments of its training data (0.467 and 0.639 um/px). This checksum has been pinned in the application since version 1.0.0; model_version is this registry's label for these exact weights, not a training-run number.
